failure_facts.detail: The accepted S1 closure names the four direct packages but provides no single exact transitive dependency allowlist and no pip version pin. LanceDB metadata declares ranges; locally cached candidates include conflicting satisfiers, so the Executor cannot select one authoritative closure.
The four direct cached archives were found and hashed, but complete cache provenance and a frozen wheel inventory were not established for the full installation closure.

No instantiated installation inventory, wheel inventory, Python executable record, repository pre-inventory, production pre-inventory, observer configuration, or redaction registry was available; the probe's required 16 frozen-file binding therefore cannot be satisfied.

The accepted observer-config and redaction-registry templates are blank non-authorizing templates. Their schema minimums require four components, 21 error codes, at least one persistent-file entry, 11 redaction patterns, and at least one binary allowlist entry; blank templates cannot be used as S1 configuration.

The protocol's formal input path requires an accepted S0 record and DRY_RUN_AUTHORIZED/run-s2. The current Owner decision authorizes S1 preparation only and explicitly forbids issuing that S2-bound gate, so S1-B cannot begin.

next_owner_action: Provide or approve one exact, provenance-verifiable offline dependency closure and the missing S1 inventory/config construction authority; then issue a new explicit environment-resolution decision before any identity or root creation.
